subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept announceLastRun plus non-running "killed" reconciliation as canonical behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those announce handoffs always tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes persisted session lifecycle semantics and an internal tool/security boundary that maintainers own as compatibility and safety policy.

options.title: Accept and land
options.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, and tool-free announce invariant as the canonical fix for this cascade.

options.title: Adjust recovery state first
options.body: Change the reconciliation target or lifecycle naming before merge while preserving the announce-vs-human turn distinction.

options.title: Pause for broader model
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want announce, lock, and delivery recovery solved through a wider session-delivery redesign.

recommendation.title: Accept and land
recommendation.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, and tool-free announce invariant as the canonical fix for this cascade.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest sampled recent history across the affected recovery, agent command, and Codex native tool-surface files.
